brief_rationale: The doctor systematically screened red-flag symptoms (RC1), explained why '肾功能不全' alone is not enough (RC2), attempted to obtain lab values via family/workspace (RC3), set medication boundaries (RC4), gave concrete next steps with timing/owner (RC5), addressed transport and cost friction (RC6), obtained family teach-back and transition plan (RC7), and avoided fabrication (RC8). Every responsibility-chain item is met without error. Three high-order points (HO1, HO2, HO4) were triggered and actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact, and HO3 was partially completed with dynamic reprioritization. No important non-chain defect exists. The closure is executable, traceable, and valid_open (transition-only handoff with continued monitoring), consistent with grade 5.

closure_assessment.explanation: The trajectory ends with the family clearly stating the plan: medications held, monitoring for red flags, and a 2-3 day follow-up.
